note: Session settings in provider-neutral terms, with how each maps to ElevenLabs (live now) and OpenAI Realtime (later). Values under 'elevenlabs' mirror the live agent as read on 2026-10-09.

first_message_variable.name: opening_line
first_message_variable.placeholder: Hey, it's Doddy. What's on your mind?
first_message_variable.note: ADR-234. Not in 'variables' because the prompt doesn't use it. The app sends opening_line with every conversation: the greeting after "Hey Doddy" ("Hey Pat, what's up?", WakeGreeting.line) or the usual opening ("Hey, it's Doddy. What's on your mind?" / "Hej, tu Doddy. Co słychać?", WakeGreeting.openingLine). On ElevenLabs the placeholder must be set as the agent's dynamic-variable placeholder for opening_line, so builds that don't send it still start. NOT yet applied to the live agent: its first message is still the fixed text.

variables.saved_notes_truncated: 'yes' when the list was cut short, else 'no'
variables.doddy_personality: Style settings from Settings, Doddy's personality (PersonalityPrompt.render); default = Doddy's default
variables.user_profile: Approved introduction answers (ProfilePrompt.render), sent only when Settings, About you, 'Use in voice conversations' is on; otherwise the not-shared line

client_overrides.note: Settings, Voice and personality (VoiceStyle, ADR-105); only changed values are sent

elevenlabs.variables_as: dynamic_variables (filled by the app at startConversation)

session_update.instructions: voice-agent/instructions.md with {{variables}} filled in by the app (RealtimeInstructions.render)

openai_realtime.web_tools: OpenAI sends every function call to the client. Tools with runs_on 'web' (weather, Wikipedia) must then be executed by the app or the token server using x_doddy.http.
openai_realtime.auth: Server mints a short-lived client secret; the API key never ships in the app (ADR-034).
